Thanks James Otieno for sending over the first draft of the risk section. This is a good start on the JC-TM Fan-out board pack. Our aim is to give the board a concise, evidence-based read so they can make key decisions on capital, risk tolerance, and digital transformation at the upcoming Q3 meeting. For the risk section, we need to move beyond qualitative insights to provide the specific data points that will enable direct decision-making.

*   Please include the NPL trajectory, highlighting the figure for this current quarter.
*   Add the single-name concentration, broken out by exposure bands.
*   List the operational risk events reported for the quarter.

If you hit any blockers or need to discuss the specific data points, please reach out to • Offer.

Thanks,
